description.content: Search for news articles using a fulltext search. All specified criteria need to be fulfilled for an article to match. Each criterion is handled according to its selectionType; "include" requires the criterion to evaluate to true, "exclude" requires the criterion to evaluate to false. A criterion is fulfilled when at least one of its values is found.
